title: Yellow Spiced Indian Lentils Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic curry made with yellow lentils, spices, and herbs, cooked to perfection in a tandoor-inspired style, with a Mediterranean twist. This dish is perfect for adventurous eaters looking to try something new and exciting.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger, and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the lentils, coriander powder, turmeric powder, red chili powder, and salt, and stir well.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Use an immersion blender to puree the curry to your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
